description: A book placed on a user's shelf, with inline book metadata and a status. The rkey is derived from the catalog book URI (last segment after the final '/'). Written by the OAuth client (livtet-service).

shelf.description: AT-URI of the parent shelf record (e.g. at://did/biblio.shelf/reading).

book.description: The book on the shelf (catalog record URI).

metadata.description: Status and optional position/notes/emoji for this book's relationship to the shelf.
